purpose: Add distinct sense-level definitions and Simplified Chinese translations for common English baseline verbs.

senses.definition: To agree to receive, take, or consider something that is offered.
senses.definitionZh: 同意接收、接受或考虑他人提供的事物。
examples: She accepted the invitation to dinner.
The company accepted our proposal.

senses.definition: To recognize something as true, valid, or unavoidable.
senses.definitionZh: 承认某事属实、有效或无法避免。
examples: It took him time to accept the truth.
She accepted responsibility for the mistake.

senses.definition: To put something together with something else or increase an amount by combining things.
senses.definitionZh: 将某物与其他事物放在一起；通过合并来增加数量。
examples: Add a little salt and stir the soup.
The shop added two new items to its menu.

senses.definition: To say something further or include extra information.
senses.definitionZh: 进一步补充说法或加入额外信息。
examples: I would like to add one more point.
She added that the meeting had been moved.

senses.definition: To agree that something is true, often reluctantly.
senses.definitionZh: 承认某事属实，通常带有不情愿的意味。
examples: He admitted that he had made a mistake.
I must admit, this is harder than I expected.

senses.definition: To allow someone to enter a place or to officially receive someone into an institution.
senses.definitionZh: 允许某人进入某处；正式接收某人进入机构或医院。
examples: Only ticket holders will be admitted to the hall.
The patient was admitted to hospital last night.

senses.definition: To let someone do something or give permission for an action.
senses.definitionZh: 允许某人做某事；准许某种行为。
examples: My parents allow me to stay out until ten.
The school does not allow food in the computer room.

senses.definition: To make something possible or provide an opportunity for it to happen.
senses.definitionZh: 使某事成为可能；为某事提供条件或机会。
examples: The new road allows traffic to move more smoothly.
This ticket allows you to enter the museum.

senses.definition: To become visible or begin to be seen.
senses.definitionZh: 变得可见；开始出现在视线中。
examples: A message appeared on my screen.
The sun appeared from behind the clouds.

senses.definition: To seem or give a particular impression.
senses.definitionZh: 看起来似乎如此；给人某种印象。
examples: He appears calm, but he is nervous inside.
The task may appear difficult at first.

senses.definition: To organize or plan an event, meeting, or activity.
senses.definitionZh: 组织或安排活动、会议或其他事项。
examples: I arranged a meeting for Friday.
Can we arrange a time to talk?

senses.definition: To put things in a particular order or position.
senses.definitionZh: 将事物按照特定顺序或位置摆放。
examples: She arranged the books by subject.
Arrange the chairs in a circle.

senses.definition: To go to an event, class, or meeting.
senses.definitionZh: 出席或参加活动、课程或会议。
examples: I attend an English class every Saturday.
Several managers attended the meeting.

senses.definition: To give attention or care to someone or something; used especially in the phrase “attend to”.
senses.definitionZh: 照料或处理某人或某事；常用于短语“attend to”。
examples: A nurse attended to the injured man.
Please attend to the customer waiting at the desk.

senses.definition: To think that something is true or that someone is telling the truth.
senses.definitionZh: 认为某事属实；相信某人说的是真话。
examples: I believe you can do it.
Do you believe that story?

senses.definition: To trust or have confidence in someone or something.
senses.definitionZh: 信任某人或某事；对其抱有信心。
examples: I believe in your ability to succeed.
She believes in giving everyone a fair chance.

senses.definition: To be the property of someone.
senses.definitionZh: 属于某人；为某人所有。
examples: This bag belongs to my sister.
Who does this jacket belong to?

senses.definition: To be a member of a group or to be in the right place.
senses.definitionZh: 属于某个群体；处于适当的位置或环境中。
examples: She belongs to a local photography club.
Those files belong in the top drawer.

senses.definition: To grow, change, or become more advanced over time.
senses.definitionZh: 随着时间成长、变化或逐渐发展。
examples: Children develop at different rates.
The town developed rapidly over the last decade.

senses.definition: To begin to have a condition, quality, or interest.
senses.definitionZh: 逐渐出现某种状况、特质或兴趣。
examples: He developed a cough during the night.
She developed an interest in photography at school.
